lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular spots posterior to the gills, displaying a roughly rectangular arrangement in the mid-lateral section with higher density towards the cephalic region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of higher pixel intensity are visible intersecting with the horizontal rows of spots, most prominent in the region above the pectoral fin insertion.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, defined by a sharp intensity gradient with high-luminance highlights on the dorsal edges and lower-luminance shadows on the ventral edges.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal fish (remoras), with one attached to the dorsal surface of the left pectoral fin and others positioned ventrally near the pectoral region.
